rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Memory provides a persistent long-term memory system for AI coding agents deployed on Cloudflare Workers. The server exposes 7 tools including memory_save and memory_search, supports streamable HTTP and stdio transports, and uses OAuth 2.1 for authentication. TypeScript implementation designed for AI agent use cases.
